title: Terms of use
excerpt: The rules that apply to using the calculators and file tools: what you can rely on, and what you cannot.
content:
These terms are short because they can be. By using Onim you agree to them. They apply to the calculator pages, the file tools, the blog, the reviews section and the contact form.

What this site is

Onim is a free library of calculators and browser-based file tools, organised into fifteen sections. Calculators are one of those sections. Nothing here costs money, there is no account to create, and no feature is withheld until you pay, sign up or watch something.

The results are a tool, not advice

Results are produced by the formulas documented on each page. They are general-purpose: they do not know your tax residency, your lender's fees, your medical history, your jurisdiction's building code or the condition of the material in front of you. For decisions with money, health, safety or legal consequences, confirm the result with a qualified professional or with the primary source — the tax office, the lender, the clinician, the code, the manufacturer's data.

The disclaimer sets out the specific limits for money, health, construction and legal results. It is part of these terms.

Files you use in a tool

The file tools run in your browser. You are responsible for the file you open and for what you do with the result. Do not use the tools to process material you have no right to process, and do not present converted or compressed output as an original where its authenticity matters — a re-encoded audio file is not a master recording, and a re-saved PDF is not evidence it never was.

Accuracy and availability

Every calculator is tested against worked examples, and a disagreement between the documented formula and the result is treated as a bug. Even so, we cannot promise the site will never be wrong or never be unavailable. Pages are provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, and results should be checked before they are relied on for anything that matters.

Where a page is known to be wrong, it is corrected rather than annotated; where a page is out of date because a rule changed — a tax band, a standard, a unit convention — the correction follows. There is no guarantee that a page you read today matches a rule that changed tomorrow.

Acceptable use

  • Do not scrape the site at a rate that degrades it for other people, and do not use automated requests to harvest the catalogue.
  • Do not use the contact form or the reviews section to send unsolicited advertising, links or repeated messages.
  • Do not attempt to reach the administration area, another visitor's message, or any data that is not yours.
  • Do not present the site's name, logo or layout as your own, or run a copy of this site that misleads people about who is behind it.

Access is not conditioned on accepting anything beyond these rules. If you break them, access may be limited or blocked without notice — in practice, that means the rate limits on the contact form and on reviews.

Content on this site

The explanatory text, the worked examples and the interface were written for this site. You may quote a short passage with a link back and a clear attribution. You may not republish whole articles, repackage the catalogue as your own product, or use the text to train a model without permission.

Formulas, unit definitions and published regulatory thresholds are facts, not property: use them freely. The written explanation of them is ours.

Reviews and contributions

When you post a review you keep the copyright in what you wrote and you give this site permission to display it on the page it belongs to. Reviews are public. Do not post anything you would not want a stranger to read: no email addresses, no phone numbers, no third parties' details. Reviews that contain links are refused automatically, and reviews that are abusive, impersonating or off-topic are removed.

Suggestions you send about how a calculator could be improved can be used to improve it, without obligation or payment. That is not a transfer of anything else you own.

Links to other sites

Some pages link to sources — a regulator, a standards body, a textbook publisher. Those sites have their own terms and their own accuracy standards. We are not responsible for what they say or do, and a link is not an endorsement of everything on the page it points to.

Liability

To the extent the law allows, Onim is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the site or from reliance on a result, including lost profit, lost data or a decision taken on the strength of a figure that turned out to be wrong. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

Changes to the site and to these terms

The site changes: calculators are added, tools are rewritten and pages are retired. These terms may change with it. When they do, the date at the top of the page changes and the change is described in the section it affects. Continuing to use the site after a change means the updated terms apply.

Which law applies

These terms are governed by the law of the operator's place of establishment, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections in your own country of residence. If a dispute cannot be resolved by writing to us first, it belongs in the courts that the law assigns.

Contact

Questions about these terms, licensing or republication go through the contact form. The privacy policy, cookie policy and disclaimer are part of the same set and are written to be read together.
